## Publish gate report: Peppermint product page

**Going out:** product page copy for the peppermint tea, published on the website.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Just peppermint leaves, nothing else." | OK. Ingredients are a product fact, checked by the product team. |
| "Cool, clean" | OK. This describes flavour. |
| "gentle on your stomach after a big meal" | **Not OK.** This is a digestive health claim. Policy section 3 bans health claims of any kind. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association." | OK. It matches the policy row word for word, and the certificate was renewed in 2026. |

**Regulated claims:** "gentle on your stomach after a big meal" suggests the tea soothes or aids digestion. That is a wellbeing claim, and we have no evidence for it. It needs to come out.

**House style:** The voice is warm, plain and unhurried, with no banned words or AI tells. Score is about 90 once the health line is removed.

**Disclosure:** None needed. This is our own product page, with no partnership, affiliate link or AI-labelling trigger.

**Fixed:** Nothing changed yet. I'm leaving the rewrite to you so the approved text is exactly what you see.

**Needs a decision:**
- Replace the health line. My suggested final copy:
  > Peppermint. Just peppermint leaves, nothing else. Cool, clean and refreshing in the cup. Certified organic by the Soil Association.
- Because the copy has to change, it needs a new check and an explicit yes on the final text.

**Evidence log rows (paste into the team log):**
- 2026-11-17 | Peppermint product page | Just peppermint leaves, nothing else | Product fact | Product team
- 2026-11-17 | Peppermint product page | Certified organic by the Soil Association | On policy list | Certificate on file, renewed 2026
- 2026-11-17 | Peppermint product page | gentle on your stomach after a big meal | Removed, health claim | None

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Please don't publish until Sam approves the revised copy.
